title: Named Non-Owner Policy Reinstatement With Lapse: Lapse-Length Relativity
content:
**Relativity on the re-write premium of a Named Non-Owner Policy term reinstated with a lapse.**

The lapse days are counted from the first lapse day attested on the latest Statement of No Loss signed for the term — the one recorded first when two share the latest document date — through the last lapse day recorded on the term, both included. A lapse with no such statement counts no days.

- 6 days or more: 1.12
- 3 to 5 days: 1.06
- 1 or 2 days, or no days counted: no relativity

The relativity multiplies the reinstatement re-write premium before that figure is rounded to the cent.

**Input — judgement — output (hypothetical).**

| Attested first lapse day | Last lapse day recorded | Days | Relativity |
|---|---|---|---|
| 11 August | 12 August | 2 | none |
| 11 August | 13 August | 3 | 1.06 |
| 11 August | 16 August | 6 | 1.12 |
| no Statement of No Loss on file | 16 August | 0 | none |
